name: Togo
famous_for: Koutammakou UNESCO fortified clay tower-houses (Takienta), Lomé Grand Marché cloth traders (Nana Benz), and voodoo markets.
tourists: Over 900,000 visitors; famous for Akodessewa Fetish Market, Koutammakou landscape, and Lake Togo pirogues.
must_know: The famous 'Nana Benz' women of Lomé built vast commercial empires in the 1970s controlling West Africa's vibrant wax-print cloth trade.
fun_fact: The Takienta two-story clay tower-houses of the Batammariba people in Koutammakou are living architectural masterpieces of fortified earthen engineering.
